SP Peralta Signs on with Boston
Boston and <Freddy Peralta:player#38620> have reached an agreement bringing the 30-year-old starting pitcher to the <Red Sox:team#4> for 6 years.

<Peralta:player#38620> reportedly signed a deal worth $250,000,000, although the financials were not disclosed to the media.

Since his debut in the league, <Peralta:player#38620> has posted 87 victories and 48 defeats with an ERA of 3.45.
